Included journals

51 journals selected using CCR Journal Watch listings dated 19 May–18 November 2026. The review parsed 2,391 unique article links, deduplicated by DOI or article URL. Counts use journal names extracted from citations; some journal names may be unresolved by the parser.

The shortlist includes journals with at least 10 parsed listings, plus Clinical Infectious Diseases, The Lancet Infectious Diseases, Anesthesiology, Current Opinion in Critical Care and Annals of the American Thoracic Society. Journal names and ISSNs were checked against Europe PMC records. Download the journal count review (CSV).

The app searches English-language PubMed records in Europe PMC from these journals, using the existing critical-care phrases over the last three calendar months. This differs from CCR’s editorial article selection and can include preclinical work. New articles update automatically; this journal shortlist is fixed until edited in scripts/journals.json.

Review sources: July–November listings and May–June archive.
